name: Freedom Travel
author: Nikuomi
description: Hold up right after entering the wave portal at 15.7% and spam slightly below the ceiling while staying above the gameplay until 16% where you can fall back into the gameplay. Navigate through the level as the wave until ~17.25% where you have to go under the gameplay between the spike and dash orb and spam slightly above the floor until 17.7% where you can move back into the gameplay as the wave. Fall to the floor between the hitboxes as the mini wave at ~19.15% shortly before your icon reaches the cube portal. Stay at the floor until 52% where you have to move to the ceiling and then can move back down to avoid a wall of spikes. Hold up to the ceiling between the platform and saw at 93%. Go under the ceiling spike at 93.4% and then hold back to the ceiling until 94% where you enter the robot portal. Play the level normally from there.
